name: Microsoft PromptFlow
description: Build, evaluate, and deploy LLM applications as visual DAG flows — chain prompts, Python, and tools, then run batch evaluations with built-in quality and safety metrics.

skills.name: Flow Execution
skills.description: Runs prompt and Python nodes as a directed graph with per-node tracing, so each intermediate output is inspectable.

skills.name: Batch Evaluation
skills.description: Executes a flow across a dataset and scores results with groundedness, relevance, and safety evaluators.

skills.name: Deployment Packaging
skills.description: Packages a flow as a Docker image or Azure managed endpoint with its dependencies and connection config.
